40023068.author: पदार्थः
40023068.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, हर्षम् joy, आपेदे attained, राघवः Rama, भ्रातृभिः with brothers, सह together, वाक्यम् words, च and, अद्भुतसङ्काशम् wonderful-like, तदा then, प्रोवाच spoke, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana.

40023068.author: Translation
40023068.content: Having heard that, Rama, along with his brothers, felt great joy and then spoke amazing words to Lakshmana.

40023069.author: पदार्थः
40023069.content: इमौ these two, कुमारौ sons, सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, तव your, धर्मविशारदौ expert in righteousness, अङ्गदः Angada, चन्द्रकेतुः Chandraketu, च and, राज्यार्थे for the sake of kingdom, दृढविक्रमौ of firm valor.

40023069.author: Translation
40023069.content: O Lakshmana, these two sons of yours, Angada and Chandraketu, are skilled in righteousness and possess firm valor suitable for kingship.

40023070.author: पदार्थः
40023070.content: इमौ these two, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I shall enthrone, देशः a region, साधु properly, विधीयताम् let it be arranged, रमणीयः charming, हि indeed, असम्बाधः unobstructed, रमेताम् let them dwell happily, यत्र where, धन्विनौ the two archers.

40023070.author: Translation
40023070.content: I shall enthrone these two in a kingdom, so let a suitable, charming, and unobstructed region be prepared where these two archers can happily reside.

40023071.author: पदार्थः
40023071.content: न not, राज्ञः of the king, यत्र where, पीडा suffering, स्यात् may be, न not, आश्रमाणां of the hermitages, विनाशनम् destruction, सः that, देशः region, दृश्यताम् let it be found, सौम्य O gentle one, न not, अपराध्यामहे we may err, यथा so that.

40023071.author: Translation
40023071.content: O gentle one, let a region be found where there is no oppression of kings or destruction of hermitages, so that we may not commit any fault.

40023072.author: पदार्थः
40023072.content: तथा thus, उक्तवति having spoken, रामे when Rama, तु indeed, भरतः Bharata, प्रत्युवाच replied, ह indeed, अयम् this, कारुपथः Karupatha, देशः region, रमणीयः charming, निरामयः peaceful.

40023072.author: Translation
40023072.content: When Rama had thus spoken, Bharata replied, "This region called Karupatha is charming and peaceful."

40023073.author: पदार्थः
40023073.content: निवेश्यतां let it be established, तत्र there, पुरम् a city, अङ्गदस्य of Angada, महात्मनः the great-souled one, चन्द्रकेतोः of Chandraketu, सुरुचिरम् very beautiful, चन्द्रकान्तम् charming like the moon (or named Chandrakanta), निरामयम् free from disease.

40023073.author: Translation
40023073.content: Let a city be established there for the great-souled Angada and another, very beautiful, moon-charming, and healthy city for Chandraketu.

40023074.author: पदार्थः
40023074.content: तत् that, वाक्यम् statement, भरतेन by Bharata, उक्तम् spoken, प्रतिजग्राह accepted, राघवः Rama, तम् that, च and, कृत्वा having made, वशे under control, देशम् region, अङ्गदस्य for Angada, न्यवेशयत् he established.

40023074.author: Translation
40023074.content: Rama accepted that statement spoken by Bharata, and having brought that region under control, he established a city for Angada.

40023075.author: पदार्थः
40023075.content: अङ्गदीया Angada's, पुरी city, रम्या beautiful, अपि also, अङ्गदस्य for Angada, निवेशिता established, रमणीया delightful, सुगुप्ता well-protected, च and, रामेण by Rama, अक्लिष्टकर्मणा whose deeds are effortless.

40023075.author: Translation
40023075.content: The beautiful city named Angadiya was established for Angada by Rama, whose deeds are effortless, and it was delightful and well-protected.

40023076.author: पदार्थः
40023076.content: चन्द्रकेतोः for Chandraketu, च and, मल्लस्य of Malla, मल्लभूम्याम् in the land of Malla, निवेशिता established, चन्द्रकान्ता Chandrakanta, इति thus, विख्याता renowned, दिव्या divine, स्वर्गपुरी a city of heaven, यथा like.

40023076.author: Translation
40023076.content: And for Chandraketu, a city named Chandrakanta was established in the land of Malla, renowned as divine, just like a city of heaven.

40023077.author: पदार्थः
40023077.content: ततः then, रामः Rama, परां great, प्रीतिम् joy, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भरतः Bharata, तथा and, ययुः attained, युद्धे in battle, दुराधर्षाः unconquerable, अभिषेकं anointment, च and, चक्रिरे they performed.

40023077.author: Translation
40023077.content: Then Rama, Lakshmana, and Bharata, who were unconquerable in battle, attained great joy and performed the anointment.

40023078.author: पदार्थः
40023078.content: अभिषिच्य having consecrated, कुमारौ the two princes, स he, प्रस्थापयति sends forth, राघवः Rama, अङ्गदं Angada, पश्चिमां to the western, भूमिं land, चन्द्रकेतुं Chandraketu, उदङ्मुखम् to the northern direction.

40023078.author: Translation
40023078.content: Having consecrated the two princes, Rama sent Angada to the western region and Chandraketu to the northern direction.

40023079.author: पदार्थः
40023079.content: अङ्गदं Angada, च and, अपि also, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अनुजगाम followed, ह indeed, चन्द्रकेतोस्तु but for Chandraketu, भरतः Bharata, पार्ष्णिग्राहो a supporter, बभूव became, ह indeed.

40023079.author: Translation
40023079.content: Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra, followed Angada, and Bharata became Chandraketu's close supporter.

40023080.author: पदार्थः
40023080.content: लक्ष्मणस्तु but Lakshmana, अङ्गदीयायां in Angada's territory, संवत्सरम् for a year, अथ then, उषितः having resided, पुत्रे his son, स्थिते having been established, दुराधर्षे unconquerable, अयोध्यां to Ayodhya, पुनः again, आगमत् returned.

40023080.author: Translation
40023080.content: Lakshmana, having resided for a year in Angada's territory until his unconquerable son was established, then returned to Ayodhya.

40023081.author: पदार्थः
40023081.content: भरतो Bharata, अपि also, तथैव similarly, उष्य having resided, संवत्सरम् for a year, अतः than that, अधिकम् more, अयोध्यां to Ayodhya, पुनः again, आगम्य having returned, रामपादावुपास्त worshipped Rama's feet, सः he.

40023081.author: Translation
40023081.content: Bharata also, having similarly resided for more than a year, returned to Ayodhya and worshipped Rama's feet.

40023082.author: पदार्थः
40023082.content: उभौ both, सौमित्रिभरतौ Lakshmana and Bharata, रामपादावनुव्रतौ devoted to Rama's feet, कालं time, गतमपि even passed, स्नेहात् due to affection, न not, जज्ञाते they knew, अतिधार्मिकौ extremely righteous.

40023082.author: Translation
40023082.content: Both Lakshmana and Bharata, being extremely righteous and devoted to Rama's feet, did not even perceive the passage of time due to their profound affection.

40023083.author: पदार्थः
40023083.content: एवं thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, दश ten, तेषां of them, ययुः passed, तदा then, धर्मे in righteousness, प्रयतमानानां of those striving, पौरकार्येषु in civic duties, नित्यदा always.

40023083.author: Translation
40023083.content: Thus, ten thousand years passed for them, who were constantly striving in righteousness and civic duties.

40023084.author: पदार्थः
40023084.content: विहृत्य having spent, कालं time, परिपूर्णमानसाः with minds completely satisfied, श्रिया with prosperity, वृताः endowed, धर्मपुरे in the city of dharma, सुसंस्थिताः well-established, त्रयः the three, समिद्धाः well-kindled, इव like, दीप्ततेजसः of blazing splendor, महाध्वरे in a great sacrifice, साधु properly, हुताः offered, त्रयः three, अग्नयः fires.

40023084.author: Translation
40023084.content: Having spent their time with fulfilled desires, endowed with prosperity, and well-established in the city of dharma, the three brothers shone like three well-kindled fires of blazing splendor, properly offered in a great sacrifice. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे व्द्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 102 ।। Thus ends the hundred and second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
